name: Corn wine
summary: Rượu ngô is highland corn wine, the cup poured beside a pot of thắng cố.
origin: Northwest highland villages, where it is drunk with thắng cố.
howToEat: Drink it with thắng cố, the way highland meals pair them.
where: Cát Cát poured it at the Gầu Tào festival stalls on 28 February 2026.
seoTitle: Ruou ngo in Sapa — corn wine with thang co
seoDescription: Rượu ngô, the corn wine drunk with thắng cố in Sa Pa, poured at the Cát Cát Gầu Tào stalls in February 2026.
